text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet, my friend, I have prepared a 
birthday present for you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Really!? Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You are fond of using aroma oils, are you 
not? This scent was blended using a novel 
pharmaceutical compound, you see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No worries, inhaling it is completely 
harmless. At most, the fine particles will 
cling to you and make you sparkle a bit—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Like a rainbow?! Wow...! And it's handmade 
too? I'm so happy! I'll cherish it 
forever!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm gonna go brag about this to 
everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so? I'm glad to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(Hmm... There shouldn't have been any 
problems, and yet I can't shake this 
restless feeling.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(............ I'll tweak it just a bit 
more before handing it over.)
